args.description: Broad swamp crab with asymmetrical iron-banded ferry-plank claws, an olive shell patterned like an old wooden deck, ochre joints and sturdy low legs. This is an original veteran ferry guardian, visually distinct from the small mud-crab. Two strongly asymmetric claws: one huge square iron-bound wooden ferry-plank pincer, one smaller curved claw. Eight sturdy low legs, broad flat deck-like olive shell. No humanoid helmet, no crown, no red mud-crab recolor. Single original East Asian pixel RPG creature facing left in a south-west three-quarter low top-down view. Authentic native pixel clusters like a 64px game sprite, with more body mass rather than finer illustrative rendering. Chunky stepped silhouettes, dark 1px outline, broad 2-3 shade color clusters, muted natural palette, no smooth gradients, no dithering, no antialiasing, no scattered single-pixel noise. Entire anatomy inside the canvas with 4px clear transparent margins on every side. No shadow, ground, background, text or extra effects.
